description: This Go source file defines functions for managing toolsets within a GitHub MCP server, including enabling toolsets, listing available toolsets, and retrieving tools within specific toolsets.

methods.name: ToolsetEnum
methods.description: Returns a list of toolset names from the provided ToolsetGroup.

methods.name: EnableToolset
methods.description: Enables a specified toolset within the server, updating its enabled status and registering its active tools.

methods.name: ListAvailableToolsets
methods.description: Lists all available toolsets with their enabled status.

methods.name: GetToolsetsTools
methods.description: Retrieves all tools within a specified toolset.
